response.overview: If a DJ clangs in the forest but no one is around to hear, should she still upload the mix?  Follow the winding journey of DJ Anaherux as she strengthens her mind, body and spirit in preparation for her biggest DJ set to date; a New Years Eve festival 50 minutes north of Auckland. The psychological and physical challenges she encounters along the way prove a difficult test.  Do not wrestle with the decks, lest ye become the decks yourself… She must listen to the music within before she can play the music out loud.
response.title: Road to Rama
